purpose: Candidate-level CDI and Spring evidence used to resolve injection bindings and framework proxy dispatch without fabricating runtime targets.

fields.candidateType: Concrete bean type or producer return type.
fields.kind: Component, producer, repository, or framework-specific bean kind.
fields.declaringType: Declaring class for a producer or component.
fields.producerMethod: Producer method name when the candidate is produced by a method.
fields.producerSignature: JVM method descriptor used to distinguish overloaded producer methods.
fields.conditions: Conditional registration evidence and evaluated condition identities.
fields.active: True or false after the selected profile/condition context is applied; null means unknown.
fields.path: Source path associated with the candidate.
fields.providerFactId: Exact provider SemanticCallFacts identity when available.

fields.injectionOwner: Type that declares the injection point.
fields.injectionMember: Constructor, field, or method identity; <init> denotes a constructor.
fields.injectionType: Type requested by the injection point.
fields.parameterIndex: Zero-based parameter index; null denotes field or an unindexed binding.
fields.qualifiers: Qualifiers applied by the framework to this injection point.
fields.selected: True for the framework-selected candidate, false for an excluded row, null when not evaluated.
fields.active: True or false after profile/condition filtering; null means unknown.
fields.selectionReason: Framework evidence explaining the selected row.
fields.providerFactId: Exact provider SemanticCallFacts identity when available.

fields.methodName: Application method dispatched through the proxy/interceptor.
fields.methodDescriptor: Optional bytecode descriptor for overloaded methods.
fields.proxyKind: CDI client proxy, Spring advisor, JDK proxy, CGLIB proxy, or equivalent.
fields.selected: True for the exact target, false for an excluded target, null when not evaluated.
fields.active: True or false after profile/condition filtering; null means unknown.
fields.providerFactId: Exact provider SemanticCallFacts identity when available.

certaintyRules.definite: Only an exact unique active binding or proxy row may promote a fact to definite.
certaintyRules.possible: Use for a bounded source candidate or proxy target when the active framework selection is not captured.
certaintyRules.unresolved: Use when qualifiers, profiles, conditions, constructor selection, or proxy target identity remain insufficiently constrained.
certaintyRules.linking: Set derivedFrom and emit enriches_without_replacing only when providerFactId is exact or one unique non-abstained provider target matches exactly.

cdi: selected active candidate metadata and client-proxy targets
spring: @Qualifier, @Primary, @Profile, common conditional annotations, and advisor targets

abstentions: open-world reflection and dynamic proxy construction
unsupported condition expressions without evaluated metadata
generated implementations and lifecycle ordering owned by FLPATH-5077
callback and ServiceLoader target selection owned by FLPATH-5078
